Chapter 1196 - 15: Ten Years (Request Subscription)

Chapter 1196: Chapter 15: Ten Years (Request Subscription)

The thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-third Fiery Sun Seed was like the final touch that completed the dragon.

The moment it formed, it resonated with the many Fiery Sun Seeds that had been gathered before.

Forming a perfect whole.

"Finally gathered."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

As early as during the war between the Qingfen Domain and the Purple Dream Domain, he was stuck on gathering the last Fiery Sun Seed.

Until now, he finally broke through the bottleneck.

It’s not that Lin Yuan lacked comprehension, but gathering the last Fiery Sun Seed required absorbing enough Fiery Sun Energy between heaven and earth.

Without sufficient Fiery Sun Energy, it couldn’t be gathered.

According to Lin Yuan’s research on the various royal family members of the Fiery Sun Ancient Kingdom and their information on gathering Fiery Sun Seeds.

Even those core royals who gathered Fiery Sun Seeds like eating and drinking, generally reached their limit at over twenty thousand Fiery Sun Seeds.

In the history of the Fiery Sun Ancient Kingdom, only eighteen royals have gathered thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Fiery Sun Seeds.

"If it wasn’t for this mansion, the time I needed to gather the last Fiery Sun Seed would have been delayed by hundreds or thousands of years."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the emperor had prepared this residence for him, which was close to the largest solar vein of the ancient kingdom, with abundant Fiery Sun Energy.

In other places, the efficiency of absorbing Fiery Sun Energy would be much worse.

"Thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Fiery Sun Seeds will form a perfect Fiery Sun Great Cycle, greatly enhancing various aspects of myself, strength? The scope of rule comprehension? All are significant."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In the history of the Fiery Sun Ancient Kingdom, those eighteen royals with the Fiery Sun Great Cycle, even if they hadn’t yet elevated their bloodline to the Heavenly Venerate level, had successfully realized the principles of Chaos Evolution Power and crossed into the realm of Heavenly Venerate through their comprehension of the Great Dao rules.

"Fluctuations in the Great Dao rules?"

Lin Yuan carefully sensed, nodding slightly.

Compared to before gathering the last Fiery Sun Seed, his comprehension of rules at this moment did indeed surge considerably.

"The creatures of this Fang Yuan World... are truly blessed by nature."

Lin Yuan felt quite emotional, even gathering just a few Fiery Sun Seeds increased their scope of rule comprehension beyond that of Chaos Void experts.

The comprehension of the Great Dao rules by the creatures of the Six Ancient Kingdoms was far easier than that of Chaos Void creatures.

The unparalleled Great Saints of Chaos Void and the Peak Venerables of the Six Ancient Kingdoms were roughly at the same level, but the latter’s comprehension of the path of Chaos Evolution Power surpassed the former.

Effortlessly bridging the gap in the inherent foundation of their body universe.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan continued to sense the impact of the Great Cycle formed by the many Fiery Sun Seeds within him.

"The Fiery Sun Divine Body has improved considerably... Divine Ability ’World’..."

Lin Yuan suddenly unfolded his divine skill world, transforming himself into a blazing Fiery Sun, under which the time and space around him began to twist, all becoming his domain.

Since the space-time within the palace was independent, Lin Yuan could activate the divine skill ’World’ here without affecting the outside world, as long as he was cautious.

"Fiery Sun..."

Lin Yuan sat at the center of the world, vaguely sensing the Fiery Sun Seeds within him lighting up one by one.

Each time a Fiery Sun Seed lit up, within the scope of the divine skill ’World’, an additional Fiery Sun appeared.

In no time, thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Fiery Suns spanned the heavenly dome of the world, combined with the Fiery Sun Lin Yuan’s body had transformed into, totaling thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-four Fiery Suns.

In an instant, Lin Yuan felt the power of the divine skill world surge, and if he wished, he could easily break through the palace’s suppression, enveloping the entire capital within the world.

Of course, if Lin Yuan dared to do so, he would be suppressed by the foundation of the capital in the next moment.

"The Fiery Sun Great Cycle... can actually have such an impact on the divine skill world?"

Lin Yuan was shocked, as this had never occurred among the eighteen royals who had the Fiery Sun Great Cycle in the past.

"Is it because of ’Fiery Sun Opening The Heavens’?"

Lin Yuan examined the ’new’ divine skill world around him, speculating in his heart.

His divine skill world had fused and devoured the source of the Fiery Sun, so the Fiery Sun Great Cycle having an effect was understandable.

As for why those eighteen royals in the past never experienced this change... they didn’t have the foundation of an inherent universe, no divine skill world, no divine skill Fiery Sun Opening The Heavens, nor did they cultivate the ’Infinite Void’ inheritance...

Lin Yuan had reached this point, with too many irreplicable traits.

"However, my current divine skill world... is much stronger than before."

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts, sensing his incredible control over the four-dimensional space and time.

The core of the divine skill world that had fused and devoured the source of the Fiery Sun was the Fiery Sun itself, and once the world was unfolded, Lin Yuan himself would transform into a Fiery Sun.

And now, the total number of such Fiery Suns amounted to thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-four, the extent of the power surge was imaginable.

Even though the Fiery Suns formed by the Fiery Sun Seeds weren’t as potent as the Fiery Sun formed by Lin Yuan’s body, the sheer number, thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three combined, had at least increased the power of the divine skill world dozens or even hundreds of times.

"The consumption is also much greater, but it can be sustained."

Lin Yuan perceived the current divine skill world, his external universe extending, wherever its power reached, the Great Dao rules of this Fang Yuan World quickly retreated.

Whoosh!

A moment later, Lin Yuan retracted the divine skill world and began to delve into research.

"With my current strength, if I fully activate the divine skill world, a powerhouse like the Red Lotus Venerable should be easily suppressed, but as for a top-tier Peak Venerable like the Red Flame Venerable..."

Lin Yuan estimated in his heart, unable to make an accurate comparison.
